mistake_reason: WebSurfer, whose defined role is limited to web browsing and summarizing online content, claimed to directly open and extract text from a local PowerPoint file and then asserted the final count (3). This action overstepped its role by performing FileSurfer’s responsibilities and making a final authoritative decision, violating role constraints (Disobey Role Specification, FM-1.2). The team then accepted this unverified result, leading to an incorrect answer.
